Megamorph {4}{G} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its megamorph cost and put a +1/+1 counter on it.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield face up or face down.

needs.what: a trigger event for a permanent being turned face up (filterable by controller: 'a permanent you control'), usable by a triggered ability with active_zones ["graveyard"] on the card itself
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine's _turn_face_up emits a 'turned_face_up' event, but it is not in the packet's trigger_events vocabulary, so no card can trigger on it; becomes_untapped/permanent_enters/counter_placed are different events (a megamorph counter would miss plain morphs and manifests)

needs.what: return_from_graveyard to the battlefield with the controller's choice of face up or face down (a face-down 2/2 that can later be turned face up for its morph cost)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: return_from_graveyard takes controller/counters/destination/tapped but has no face_down option; face_down exists only on look_at_top/reveal_until/search_library, and manifest puts library cards, not this card from the graveyard
